description:
A leaf from a court register. Contains four different entries, dated to Nissan and Sivan 1409 Sel. (Spring 1098 CE). 
On left hand of Verso, and continues to right side of Recto and then concludes on top left side of Verso, is a court document concerning a Siddur that was purchased. Persons named as concerned (line 1) are Abu Fadl b. al-Assal and Ibn al-Lawwaz Sar Shalom b. Yakhin the cantor. Signed by Yiṣḥaq b. Shemuel, Avraham b Shema'ya, and Nissim b. Nahray, who were active, signing documents, at the beginning of the 12th century in Fustat. (Information from Goitein's index cards).
description_he: עלה מפנקס בית דין. מכיל ארבעה רשומות שונות, מתוארכות לניסן וסיון 1409 סל. = אביב 1098. כולל מסמך הנוגע לסידור שנרכש, חתום על ידי יצחק ב' שמואל, אברהם ב' שמעיה ונסים ב' נהריי.
